turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.
Please send your order number, the email address you used at checkout, and the full new delivery address so I can check whether the address can be changed.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.
Your order has already shipped, so I couldn’t change the delivery address. A colleague will take over to see what options are available. The address hasn’t changed.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Verified nora.blake@example.com requests delivery change to Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu, and says parcel should not go to checkout address. Policy check denied change because already shipped. No change filed; please review options.
